# meshstack_workspace_user_group (Data Source)

Read a workspace user group by its identifier and the workspace that owns it. For a global group, set `metadata.owned_by_workspace` to `meshcloud-global-partner`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_workspace_user_group" "example" {
  metadata = {
    name               = "my-user-group"
    owned_by_workspace = data.meshstack_workspace.example.metadata.name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Identifiers of the workspace user group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))

### Read-Only

- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to this workspace user group, can be used as `group_ref` in `meshstack_workspace_user_group_member`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ref))
- `spec` (Attributes) Configuration of the workspace user group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) Information meshStack keeps about the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Identifier of the workspace user group.
- `owned_by_workspace` (String) Identifier of the workspace that owns the group.


<a id="nestedatt--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.
- `name` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of the `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.
- `owned_by_workspace` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of the `meshWorkspace` that owns the `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Name of the group as meshPanel shows it.
- `egid` (String) Identifier of the group in the system it comes from, such as your identity provider.
- `members` (Set of String) Usernames of the group's members.
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Tags of `meshWorkspaceUserGroup`.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `disabled_usernames` (Set of String) Members whose user is disabled, for example by SCIM.
- `source_system` (String) System that manages the group, such as `SCIM` for a group your identity provider synchronizes.
